title: Concept: Request body size limit disabled in the server configuration in nginx — review required
description: In nginx, the body limit is removed. nginx buffers or streams the body before the application sees it, so the limit is the first line of defence against oversized uploads. Setting it to zero is often a quick fix for a large file test and remains in the deployed configuration.
applicability: nginx web servers that accept uploads.
risk: Resource exhaustion through oversized requests; LOW severity.
